name: Collateral Applied Excess 1 Code
definition: Specifies if the collateral reported is applied or in excess.

APLD.name: Applied
APLD.definition: Collateral used by the collateral receiver to discharge liabilities owed to it by the collateral provider.

EXCS.name: Excess
EXCS.definition: Collateral held by the collateral receiver either in anticipation of future liabilities or towards previously liabilities no longer owed to it.
